lines.en: The grass reaches my knees; I walk steadily.
My mane brushes the tips of the grass.
I have patrolled this savanna a thousand times.
The lionesses lead; I take the rear.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方，草会伏下。
lines.en: Where I step, the grass lies down.
The sun is fierce; I keep to the shade.
The acacia's shadow is long.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但没人催我。
lines.en: I do not walk fast, and no one hurries me.

lines.zh: 脚下的土是干的，会扬灰。
lines.en: The earth is dry and kicks up dust.
I skirt the ant mound without stepping on it.
I only take this path at night.
The wind comes from the right; I tilt my head to smell.

lines.zh: 我的爪子收着，走路没声。
lines.en: My claws are sheathed; I walk in silence.
At the boundary stone, I turn back.
I cross the dry riverbed.
Dry grass is stuck in my mane.
I lie down and swing my tail slowly.
I sleep a great deal of the day.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的低鸣，是给同伴的。
lines.en: The low rumble is for my pride.
I lick my forepaw and smooth my fur.
The sun heats my mane.
Vultures circle in the distance.
I hear the cubs tussling.
This stone is the king's seat.
I yawn, and my teeth show.
Insects chirp in the grass; annoying.
My eyes are half shut; my ears turn.
An empty savanna puts me at ease.
I am waiting for the sun to drop.
The wind blows my mane into my face.
A flick of my tail clears a fly.
The herd far off is heading north.

lines.zh: 你的靴子越过了我的界线。
lines.en: Your boots have crossed my boundary line.
I look up at you without rising.
You smell of stone and iron.

lines.zh: 你手里那截铁，亮得刺眼。
lines.en: That length of iron in your hand is glaring bright.
I am staring to weigh you.
Do not reach for my mane.
Step back, and I will not follow.
My eyes are in shadow.
You are blocking my sunlight.
Did you come here alone?
I smell salted meat in your pack.
Stare a moment longer, and I will roar.
You cut my shoulder.
I roar once, and the grass trembles.
This blood is nothing.
I fall back half a step, then stand firm.

lines.zh: 你打在我鬃毛最厚的地方。
lines.en: You struck where my mane is thickest.
My ear stings from the blow.
Pain makes me want to bite.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，血珠飞出去。
lines.en: I shake my head; blood flies off.
Your courage is fine; your strength is not.

lines.zh: 你的气味，我刻在鼻子里。
lines.en: I have carved your scent into my nose.
Put the meat down and stop trembling.

lines.zh: 你拿肉的样子，像在喂猫。
lines.en: You offer meat as if feeding a cat.
I do not eat grass; you are mistaken.
This meat still has blood; good.
First I must sniff your hand.
Take two steps back, then I eat.
The meat is too small to fill a gap in my teeth.
My lowering my head does not mean I obey.

lines.zh: 生肉的味道，盖过你的汗。
lines.en: The raw meat overpowers your sweat.

lines.zh: 你把肉举高，是在戏弄我。
lines.en: Holding it high, you are mocking me.
I come closer; do not move suddenly.
Eating your meat, I will remember you.
I could snatch it in one bite.

lines.zh: 第二块，我才考虑跟你走。
lines.en: For the second piece, I might follow you.
Do not reach that close.
I take this meat and go.
You hit my shoulder and bounced off.
My mane brushed all over you.
Do not come at me from behind.
I step aside once, and only once.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖碰到了我的肋。
lines.en: Your knee met my ribs.
I gave a low warning.
That force will not move a lion.

lines.zh: 你的脚跟压住了我的尾梢。
lines.en: Your heel pressed down on my tail's tip.
I shake my head; my mane ruffles.
Push again, and I will shoulder you.
She walks ahead; I keep half a body behind.

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛越黑，她越看我。
lines.en: The darker my mane, the more she looks.
We take turns watching the cubs.

lines.zh: 这一季，草原上都是吼声。
lines.en: This season, the savanna is full of roars.
She flicks her tail across my face.
The cubs bite my ears.
I leave the best meat for her.
Another male watches from beyond the line.
We walked side by side a long while.
She lies down; I keep watch beside her.
I carry the meat into the shade.
This bone goes to the cubs.
I bite it and shake off the dirt.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，我先闻再碰。
lines.en: Whatever you drop, I sniff before touching.
I carry a cub gently by the scruff.
I will keep this fur to line the den.
One piece of meat cannot feed the pride.
I take it with my mouth, not my claws.
That feather does not interest me.
I hide it in the grass.
The zebra herd is at the river.
That boar has left the herd.
The horse has long legs, but it stumbles.
The rhino is too big; I hesitate.
A young one lags behind.
I crouch; the grass covers me.
The wind blows toward me; good.
Its shadow is moving.
I pick the weakest one.
Tonight's prey is decided.
I hug the grass and creep closer.

lines.zh: 它一抬头，我就伏进草里。
lines.en: It lifts its head; I drop into the grass.
My tail stops swinging.
Ten paces still to go.
I count its breaths.
The grass is dry; footsteps carry.
It is heading for the water.
I move around to the downstream side of the wind.
My claws are already out.
A little closer, and it will be too late.
I leap and pin its shoulder.
One bite to the throat, quick.
My claws tear the turf.
It kicked me; that hurt.
One twist of my head flips it over.
The roar arrives before the teeth.

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛挡住了它的角。
lines.en: My mane caught its horn.
This kill will feed the pride.
It broke free; I did not chase far.
I am panting hard, but standing firm.

lines.zh: 我从金合欢的影子里走出。
lines.en: I step out of the acacia's shadow.

lines.zh: 这片稀树草原，有了主人。
lines.en: This savanna now has a master.

lines.zh: 太阳升起，我的鬃毛先亮。
lines.en: The sun rises; my mane lights first.
When I land, the grass bows.
An answer comes from far away.
I was born in the dry season.
The wind brings the savanna's scent.
First I roar to draw the boundary.
The lionesses wait for my return.
This land is large enough for me.
Fire chases my mane; I run for the river.

lines.zh: 从岩上跌下，我翻身站起。
lines.en: I fall from the rock and roll to my feet.
Water fills my nose; I paddle hard.
The blast leaves my ears muffled.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的肋，留了道槽。
lines.en: The arrow grazes my ribs and leaves a groove.

lines.zh: 有股味道钻进我的鼻子。
lines.en: A strange tang crawls into my nose.
Too hungry even to roar.
Lightning hits a tree; I flatten myself.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我抓不住任何东西。
lines.en: The ground is gone; I cannot grip anything.
